findings.summary: Minus signs on every fund's difference look like losses; the meaning is only explained in a small note at the bottom.
The page opens with English letters and the word מדד (index), which tells someone looking for safe saving that it isn't for them.
The same 'not in the calculation / different price for young people, soldiers...' note repeats on almost every bank row, so the reader has to reread each one to find what differs.
The cost bars' colour key is on another screen, so the colours can't be matched, and orange and yellow look almost the same.
Nothing says whether this is as safe as a deposit or how much it could drop, and it assumes 7% a year.
Long rows of numbers make the screen busy and caused anxiety.
